items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: And Stafford, Joe Stafford, he was trombone player.

ctx.x: And we went into a place they had there, half of the place was for dancing and the other was for rollerskating and we played in the dance section and I remember we had a fellow in that band, Louie Jones. He was a great violin player from New York and he was from Boston, but he was a very great violinist.
Can you name any other guys that were in that band around that time. Remember any of the fellows' names.
Oh, gee, fellow named Gulfport, he was in the band. He was a comedian.
